'If you have played a non-attack action card this turn, you may play this from your banished zone. IF YOU DO, it gains +1{p}. Blood Debt' -- Blood Debt is printed and fires from the card DB, deliberately not authored.

THE PERMISSION IS CONDITIONAL AND THE ENGINE WAS NOT ASKING. play._self_playable_from_banished read the STATIC's declared effect types and ignored its conditions, so any card of this shape could be played from banish in every state -- not a smaller version of the card but a free one. 13 cards write the permission this way; the conditions are now evaluated whenever there is a state to evaluate them against.

'IF YOU DO' IS PLAYED_FROM_ZONE, not a flag. The +1{p} belongs to the copy that was actually played out of the banished zone, and this card can also be played normally from hand -- where it must NOT get the bonus.
